observable_outcomes: Five-pillar status is derived from evidence and uses passed, failed, partial, or indeterminate semantics.
Memory distinguishes cache reuse from relevant retrieval, prompt injection, and trusted use.
Routing proves that the policy decision, worker request, and observed runtime identity match.
Managed runs enforce legal state transitions, idempotency, retry allowlists, and hard budgets.
Acceptance separates evidence integrity, standard adequacy, and the product verdict.
Dogfood requires an installed wheel A to manage a Pacer change, a fresh wheel B to pass its own trusted check, and GitHub OIDC provenance to reach the 95-point CI target.
Release readiness stops on the first failure and requires a clean three-repository by five-scenario matrix.
boundary_cases: A new launch with no evidence is indeterminate rather than failed.
A successful response cache lookup without relevant memory cannot pass Memory.
Timeouts, HTTP 5xx responses, crashes, and rejected evidence remain failures.
Template-only acceptance criteria cannot produce a product pass.
Repeated evidence or run identity and candidate wheel drift reset the clean release streak.
